title: MZ RPG Maker MZ: Skill that gives an extra action on use

posts.author: Zavemann
posts.body:
Hello! I am learning RPG maker with some friends, and am putting together a practice game to test some things out. I am trying to create a skill that gives the user an extra turn when they use it, effectively making the skill "free". After some searching, people keep pointing to a YEP plugin, but this project is working in MZ 1.9.0 and FOSSIL isn't compatible with 1.8 and above.
"Action times+" isn't what I'm looking for, as it's chance based and has potential to cascade into more than one bonus turn, whereas I am looking to give a skill- and only this skill- a 100% chance of effectively not taking up the player's action.
I am not picky as to whether this is done by giving an extra turn or just not consuming the turn for the skill so long as this is the effect.
While I would prefer a free option, I am looking for any methods or Plugins that can do this in RPG maker MZ
1.9.0
paid or otherwise. If paid, please explain how this can be used to achieve this effect or point to documentation that the plugin does this specifically!
Any and all help would be greatly appreciated. Cheers!

Sorry for the delayed response! I've since given this a try, but it doesn't seem to work or isn't designed for what I was hoping. As far as I can tell, YEP plugins aren't compatible with RPG maker MZ, so I want to double check that this doesn't have any dependencies and remind that I am working in RPG maker MZ 1.9.0, which means I don't have access to FOSSIL. Regardless, I made sure to try it out just in case.
Per the instructions in the plugin description, I attempted to mark the skill with "<Instant>" and "<Instant Cast>", as well as the "Instant Eval" method. Putting the effect of the skill itself aside just to test if it would allow for another turn, that looked like this:
<Instant Eval>
if (user.tp >= 1) instant = true;
</Instant Eval>
I also tested this with "a.tp" just to be sure, but neither had the desired effect. I attempted this both in the format used in the plugin description and without spaces in case it was sensitive to the formatting, but this had no effect either.
If there was any lack of clarity in the description of what I was looking for, I apologize! Further, thank you for your effort! If you would be willing to try and troubleshoot this- should I not just be missing something simple- let me know! I'm relatively new to scripting (especially for JS), but I've cobbled together a handful of scripts I couldn't find and would love the chance to see what you're getting at.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Didn't check the plugin posted above and don't know what battle system you plan on using, but some VisuStella battle systems (like STB ) allow extra action.
